prompt: Create an original production animation sprite sheet for a top-down 2D pixel art RPG, transparent RGBA background. Square 1024x1024 canvas, EXACTLY four rows and four columns, 16 equal square cells, no borders or labels. Every cell is centered inside its own grid cell with at least 24px transparent padding, NEVER overlaps neighbors. Rows are four DIFFERENT VFX animations; columns are four consecutive animation keyframes: gathering/anticipation, energetic release, strongest readable impact, scattered dissipating residue. Same center and size per row, convincing motion changing shape between frames, not four copies or four sizes of the same ornament. No characters, weapons as objects, UI icons, text, scenery, black backdrop, checkerboard backdrop, or decorative emblems. Sharp high-quality SNES/modern indie pixel art with clean pixel clusters, limited 4-6 tone ramps and tiny crisp highlights. Solid forms plus true transparent negative space, no smooth blurry gradients. These are actual animated EFFECT sprites, not concept illustrations or inventory icons. Prioritize powerful expressive kinetic silhouettes, with direction and motion. Palette pearl-white steel, crimson and deep garnet, minimal warm orange. Martial sword master: energy blades, NOT fire. Row1: broad beautiful crescent katana slash sweeping left to right, expanding then splitting into narrow crimson and white ribbons; razor-sharp tips, two trailing ink-like sword marks. Row2: a forward-facing pointed crescent sword-qi projectile moving to the right, slender tapered pale core, crimson filament trails, dissolve into tiny sharp fragments. Row3: concentrated crossed sword-cut impact, first two converging streaks then an explosive jagged white star and angular crimson shards, finally a few silver splinters. Row4: horizontal world-cleaving sword seam across almost the cell width, a dramatic thin white razor line with multiple uneven crimson ink tears and displaced sharp strands, then broken crimson fissure fragments. Energetic brushstroke forms, strong timing, minimal flat badges.
